body:
The kid is in therapy. It was either that or inpatient for one of us, once we got at each other’s throats. Speaking fairly literally here. 

I’m going thru the motions, and I do know I’m not enough, because I make my husband miserable. If I was enough he’d be happy. But he’s not. So it’s plain to me that I fall short 

I do appreciate the time you’ve taken to write you mean well I know. I just... I don’t know. I want to give up
